title: The Michelin Star and the Finale

scenes.title: A Bolt in the Lentil Soup
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov learns a guest found a metal bolt in his lentil soup and suspects the guest is a con artist.

scenes.title: The Inspector from Paris
scenes.summary: Barinov discovers the guest with the bolt is chief Michelin inspector Patrick Malouda from Paris.

scenes.title: The Wheelchair Story
scenes.summary: Mikhail tells Malouda that Chef Viktor is paralyzed, while Nastya's mother suspects Kostya's father is a fraud.

scenes.title: The Paternity Test
scenes.summary: Nastya and her parents decide to run a secret DNA paternity test on Kostya's supposed father.

scenes.title: A Culinary Hero
scenes.summary: With Barinov posing in a wheelchair, Mikhail tells Malouda that pain kept Viktor from cooking the soup himself.

scenes.title: A Second Chance and Nikita's Threat
scenes.summary: Malouda agrees to return for dinner, while outside Nikita confronts Denis about the ruined wedding.

scenes.title: The Main Ingredient
scenes.summary: Thugs confront Denis outside, while Mikhail convinces Barinov to keep up the wheelchair act for Malouda.

scenes.title: A Trap for Nikita
scenes.summary: Mikhail persuades Barinov to play along, while Nikita gets kidnapped alongside Denis when he tries to stop the thugs.

scenes.title: Rivals in Captivity
scenes.summary: Denis and Nikita argue while tied up together, and their captors leave a single guard watching them.

scenes.title: The Missing Wheelchair
scenes.summary: Nastya collects a saliva sample from Kostya, while at the hotel someone steals Chef Barinov's wheelchair right before Malouda arrives.

scenes.title: Escape Plan in the Basement
scenes.summary: Mikhail tells Barinov to hide until Senya and Fedya find a wheelchair, while Denis and Nikita trick their guard.

scenes.title: The Stolen Wheelchair
scenes.summary: Spotting Malouda outside, Barinov throws himself on the ground and pretends his wheelchair was just stolen.

scenes.title: The Inspector's Request and the Clinic Meeting
scenes.summary: Malouda asks to watch Barinov cook in person, while Nastya and her mother bump into each other at the testing clinic.

scenes.title: Quarrel Over the Grandfather
scenes.summary: Afraid that Kostya's supposed father will kidnap Styopa, Nastya reveals that Kostya's grandmother did not recognize the man.

scenes.title: The Father's Confession and Dinner for Malouda
scenes.summary: Kostya throws Timofey Ilyich out after his confession, while Chef Barinov prepares goose breast in a wheelchair for Malouda.

scenes.title: The Chef's Miraculous Recovery
scenes.summary: Right after Malouda promises Barinov a Michelin star, Barinov jumps out of his wheelchair to save Katya from the thugs.

scenes.title: The Test Result and Reconciliation
scenes.summary: Nastya's DNA test proves that Timofey Ilyich truly is Kostya's biological father, and Kostya rushes to bring him back.

scenes.title: An Honest Talk with the Inspector
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov apologizes to Malouda for the wheelchair deception while defending his culinary talent.

scenes.title: A Culinary Fanatic
scenes.summary: Mikhail tells Malouda the real truth about Barinov's recent coma, his passion for cooking, and how he saved them from the thugs.

scenes.title: The Little Kitchen of Happiness
scenes.summary: Katya announces that she and Denis are expecting a baby, and Chef Barinov finally wins his Michelin star.
